name: oncall-latency-dashboard
useWhen: User is debugging a slow or timing-out request path and hasn't mentioned checking metrics yet.
context: Reminder: check the latency dashboard at grafana.internal/d/api-latency before guessing at the bottleneck.

name: mcp-jira
useWhen: User wants to look up, create, or update a Jira ticket, or references a ticket key like PROJ-123.
context: A Jira MCP server is connected — use it instead of asking the user to paste ticket details.

name: deploy-cloudflare-page
useWhen: User wants to deploy a static site directory to Cloudflare Pages or set up a custom pages.dev subdomain — e.g. "deploy to cloudflare pages", "ship to cf pages", "publish to pages.dev".

name: clean-slate
useWhen: User is replacing, removing, or cleaning up something with a prior version — code, config, docs, infra, or the assistant's own response — and the result should read as if born in its current form, with no leftover trace of the old version.
